_doc: ATC facility data that the airport data does not carry. names: spoken airport names (radio call-sign prefix) where the derived name from the airport name is wrong. controlled_unpublished: small fields that have a tower in reality but no frequency in the data (calls are answered on any COM1 frequency). departure_routes: optional VFR departure route text per airport (empty = generic clearance). Large and medium airports without published frequencies are also answered on any frequency; small fields and heliports without frequencies are treated as uncontrolled (blind calls).
